thread:
carmen: Heads up — BrightRoot will kick off a security review next Wed 06/10. Scope includes RBAC changes (org-wide role mappings), KMS key policy review, and audit-log retention. Need owners, evidence location, and a retest window.

 dave: OK — can we carve a 2hr window during business hours for assessor access? prefer 14:00-16:00 PT. Also need to know whether we'll grant ephemeral role or presigned artifacts.

 alice: I can own the KMS/key-policy piece. For assessor access I prefer ephemeral IAM role via STS + short-lived creds. We should also enable an audit sink to the secure-log-bucket for the window.

 ben: I can handle RBAC changes. Plan: create a dedicated reviewer role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/brightroot-reviewer` with `MaxSessionDuration=3600` and add a condition limited to the review window. We'll rotate after.

 security-bot: Checklist: 1) Evidence bucket path confirmed 2) Ephemeral role deployed 3) KMS key policy snapshot uploaded 4) Audit sink enabled 5) Smoke test of readonly access 6) Post-review revoke. See https://internal.runbooks/sec-review-checklist

 carmen: Evidence location — please upload artifacts to s3://secure-evidence/brightroot/2026-06-10/ and tag uploads with `review-id: BR-2026-06-10`. Use presigned URLs only for large DB dumps; otherwise use the KMS-wrapped uploads flow.

 dave: Quick Q on KMS proxy — can we avoid giving the assessor direct decrypt? They only need to verify key policy and attempt a wrap/unwrap test. If so we should proxy any wrap/unwrap calls and log them.

 alice: Yes — we'll enable a KMS proxy role that returns only `kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext` calls for the window. Sample IAM snippet for assume-role:```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/brightroot-reviewer --role-session-name brightroot-session --duration-seconds 3600
```

 ben: For RBAC patches, plan to do a canary rollout on the auth service route first (5% traffic). If anything spikes in 15m we'll roll back via feature-flag. Owner: @ben. Ticket: SEC-4582.

 carmen: Who can prepare the KMS key-policy diff and evidence (current policy + proposed minimal policy)? Need that by Mon EOD.

 alice: I'll drop the policy diff into the evidence path and include a short playbook for the proxy. Example policy change (inline):
```json
{"Sid":"AllowReviewRole","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/brightroot-reviewer"},"Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"],"Condition":{"DateGreaterThan":{"aws:CurrentTime":"2026-06-10T14:00:00Z"},"DateLessThan":{"aws:CurrentTime":"2026-06-10T16:00:00Z"}}}
```

 infra-oncall: Calendar invite created for Wed 2026-06-10 14:00-16:00 PT and pinned to #eng-security. I created the ephemeral role and put ARNs in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

 dave: For vulnerability triage — how will we track findings? Do we want assessor issues to land in a triage board or send to owning teams directly?

 ben: Use the SEC tracker — any high/critical findings auto-create a P0 in the oncall channel and assign owner by resource tag. We should also allow assessors to create attachments into SEC-4582 so we have raw repro steps.

 carmen: Retest coordination: ask BrightRoot for a retest slot within 7 days post-remediation. I'm proposing we hold Thu 06/18 09:00-11:00 PT as a tentative retest slot. If remediation completes earlier we can accelerate.

 alice: Add telemetry checks: enable `auth.audit` verbose mode for the two-hour window and increase KMS audit sampling to 100%. We'll keep logs for 90 days and export samples to the security S3.

 security-bot: Action items created: SEC-4582 (RBAC canary + rollback), SEC-4583 (KMS proxy + policy diff), SEC-4584 (evidence upload + audit sink). Owners: ben, alice, carmen.

 carmen: Thanks — I'll ping BrightRoot with the tentative windows and ask them to confirm pre-review questionnaire. If anyone hits blockers on evidence upload, ping me. :thumbsup:

 ben: One more thing — carve out a 30min dry-run on Tue 06/09 14:00 PT to validate assumes + audit pipeline. Can infra-oncall schedule that?

 infra-oncall: Dry-run scheduled Tue 06/09 14:00 PT. Will post the runbook link and test logs.

 carmen: Perfect. Closing coordination thread — we'll use SEC tickets above for followups.
